speaker: george_bryan
text: You wait where I put you. A passage, then a room, and the room is plain on purpose. Do not wander in order to feel busy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The towers are seen. The waiting is the work, and it will be longer than we like. I am not going to dignify it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou goest in first, when it is time. The line is the line thou hast. Do not grow it in a corridor.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not grow it. Paper crown. The old velvet. I am not wearing either of them in this passage.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: You said about ten. Is about ten the true hour, or is the chair empty until you say otherwise?

speaker: george_bryan
text: The house has nine, after supper. At nine the chair is not empty. Until nine you bow to it as if it were, and you do not look up to be praised for the bow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I told him about ten, yesterday, because about ten was the answer I had. Nine is the house. I am not mending either of them in a passage.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Then I have two hours, and one bow. Which bow do I spend?

speaker: george_bryan
text: You spend the bow I give you in the room. A clock is not a master. A yeoman is not a conversation. If one speaks, you find me.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And thou, Sam, stay where thou art put. A hall is not a yard. A whisper in it is a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick stays under the note. He is here to be in the picture of the company, not to prove a voice. Four days became more days. They are still in force.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can bow to an empty chair. I did it at the Theatre. I want the one with a person in it to be different, or the practice was a trick.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The practice was the practice. The person is the Queen's, and she is not yours to discuss. God keep you until the room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. About ten stands as what I said. Nine stands as what the house said. I can carry both as far as the door.
